questions.text: Where should the JWT be issued? REQ-339 says the server signs and issues the token, but apps/api/app/auth/jwt.py says tokens are issued elsewhere by a Node API that is not in this repository.
options: Issue tokens in the Python API (apps/api), in this work item
Tokens come from the existing external Node API; this work item only verifies them and the Python API does not issue them
questions.reason: Decides whether sign-up and sign-in endpoints, password hashing and token signing are built in apps/api or only consumed from elsewhere.

questions.text: Are password reset flows part of this work item, or a follow-up requirement?
questions.reason: REQ-339 names password reset under Security Baselines, but the mock and acceptance criteria do not show it, so the scope of this work item is unclear.
